g.title: input
g.text: Cine MRI: T × Z × H × W
At fixed t: z−1, z, z+1

g.title: window
g.text: Q from M · K/V from D2

g.title: fuse
g.text: Crop back to original spatial extent

g.title: head
g.text: Center-slice logits: BG / RV / MYO / LV

g.title: output
g.text: Inference: repeat for every z and t
Native-grid probabilities: T × Z × 4 × H × W
Volume Dice per labeled frame → patient mean

g.title: note
g.text: Feature sizes omit B; shown for crop256. Inference uses native H/W with internal padding.
R = GELU(x + Conv3×3 → GroupNorm → GELU → Conv3×3 → GroupNorm).
Dashed edges are active long skips. A0 has no external target, memory correction or meta-Dice.
Existing A1 adds a training loss; A2–A6 add memory correction from D1 to logits.
Source model: 8252760 · executed-source hashes verified against results at fa7a866.
